#### Razorpay API Key

* The public key provided by Razorpay for API integration.

#### Razorpay Secret Key

* The confidential key used alongside the API Key to secure transactions.

#### Razorpay Webhook Secret Key

* A key used to validate webhook requests from Razorpay.
* This is the <html style="color : red">most recommended</html>to setup webhook
* Please read <html style="color : red">'To Setup Webhook'</html>which is given below for setup webhook.

***

#### To Generate Razorpay Api Key and Secret Key

* **Sign Up / Log In:**
  * If you don’t have an account, sign up at [Razorpay](https://razorpay.com/). If you already have one, simply log in to your Razorpay dashboard.
* **Switch Environment**
  * Make sure you have in Production Mode.
* **Navigate to API Settings:**
  * In your Razorpay dashboard, look for the “Settings” option in the sidebar.
  * Within Settings, find and click on “API Keys” or a similar option related to API credentials.
* **Generate the API Key Pair:**
  * Click on the “Generate Key” button.
  * You might be asked to enter your account password as a security step.
* **Copy and Save Your Keys:**
  * Once generated, you will see both your API key (often called “Key ID”) and your secret key.
  * **Important:** The secret key is displayed only once. Make sure to copy it and store it securely (for example, in a secure password manager or a safe place on your computer).
  * Now copy the keys And paste it here in the **Razorpay API Key** and **Razorpay Secret Key** column.
* **Use Your Keys Safely:**
  * Do not share your secret key with anyone.

***

#### To Setup Webhook

* **Log In to Your Razorpay Dashboard:**
  * Visit [Razorpay](https://razorpay.com/) and log in with your credentials.
* **Navigate to the Webhooks Section:**
  * In the dashboard sidebar, click on **Settings**.
  * Look for the **Webhooks** option. (If it’s not immediately visible, check under integration or API settings.)
* **Add a New Webhook:**
  * Click the **Add New Webhook** (or similar) button.
  * In the form that appears, enter your **Webhook URL**. This is the endpoint on your server where you want to receive webhook events.
  * The **Webhook URL** should be: <html style="color : red">https://{yourdomainName}/api/public/webhook/razor-pay/payment</html>
  * eg: [https://example.com/api/public/webhook/razor-pay/payment](https://example.com/api/public/webhook/razor-pay/payment)
* **Select Events to Subscribe To:**
  * You’ll see a list of available events such as **Payment Captured**, **Payment Failed**, etc.
  * Select these events:
    * <html style="color : red">payment.captured</html>
    * <html style="color : red">payment.failed</html>
    * <html style="color : red">payment.authorized</html>
    * <html style="color : red">order.paid</html>
    * <html style="color : red">refund.processed</html>
    * <html style="color : red">refund.failed</html>
    * <html style="color : red">refund.created</html>
  * Check the events that are relevant to your application so that Razorpay sends notifications for those events.
* **Set a Webhook Secret Key**
  * Enter a <html style="color : red">Secret Key</html>This secret is used by Razorpay to sign the webhook payload.
  * Insert this same Secret Key here also **Webhook Secret Key** column.
  * Make sure you store this secret securely.
* **Save Your Webhook Configuration:**
  * Once you’ve entered the URL, selected the events, and set a secret, click **Save** or **Create Webhook** to finalize the setup.
